name: labs/miked63017__dinolite_uvc_led_control
title: Dino-Lite UVC LED control (dinoliteuvccontrol.DinoLiteUVCControl)
intro: Dino-Lite UVC LED control (dinoliteuvccontrol.DinoLiteUVCControl), adapted from miked63017/dinolite_uvc_led_control. It reads `main_led_on`, `flc_on`, `flc_brightness`, `auto_exposure` and 3 more; runs `set_illumination`, `set_flc_brightness`, `toggle_flc_led`, `toggle_auto_exposure` and 2 more. `set_illumination`: turn the main LED or the FLC illumination on or off. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
